一个可插拔的桌面应用模板：配置即开关，一条命令加一个新工具。不用懂架构，照着文档.message: A pluggable desktop app template: toggle by config, add a tool with one command. No architecture knowledge needed — read the docs and write your page.

每个工具是一个独立模块，互不干扰；加一个、关一个都只改一行配置。.message: Every tool is an independent module. Add or hide one by editing a single line of config.

每个功能包自带页面、IPC 与多语言。一条命令生成骨架并自动接入宿主，不用碰任何.message: Each feature owns its page, IPC, and i18n. One command scaffolds it and wires it into the host — no registration logic to touch.

改一行 enabledFeatures，工具上架或下架，无需任何命令。.message: Edit one line in enabledFeatures to show or hide a tool. No commands.

内置 i18n，运行时切换 zh-CN / en-US，文案按命名空间拆分。.message: Built-in i18n, runtime switch between zh-CN / en-US, copy split by namespace.

暗色模式、统一结构化日志、Vitest + Playwright 开箱即用。.message: Dark mode, unified structured logging, Vitest + Playwright out of the box.

三步加一个新工具.message: Add a tool in three steps

一条命令生成功能包骨架，自动接入宿主。.message: One command scaffolds the feature package and wires it into the host.

启动应用，侧边栏就能看到你的新工具。.message: Start the app and your new tool appears in the sidebar.

只改一个文件（renderer.tsx），把示例换成你的逻辑。.message: Edit a single file (renderer.tsx) and replace the sample with your logic.

开箱即用的地基.message: A solid foundation out of the box

中英双语，命名空间拆分，新增语言即插即用。.message: Bilingual, namespaced copy, drop in more languages anytime.

主进程与渲染进程统一 logger，内置日志查看页。.message: One logger across main and renderer, with a built-in log viewer.

亮色 / 暗色 / 跟随系统，Tailwind v4 变量驱动。.message: Light / dark / system, driven by Tailwind v4 variables.

Vitest 单元测试 + Playwright E2E，CI 自动跑。.message: Vitest unit tests + Playwright E2E, run automatically in CI.

Biome 同时管 lint 与 format，零配置陷阱。.message: Biome handles both lint and format — no config traps.

electron-builder 三平台打包 + GitHub Release.message: electron-builder three-platform packaging + GitHub Release + auto-update.

三分钟跑通，之后就是一个个往上加。.message: Up and running in three minutes, then keep adding.
